long_biography.plain_text:
Silvasan began in telecommunications, building several businesses from the ground up. He founded TelePlus World in 1999, took it public and later sold most of his telecommunications assets. That cycle gave him experience in acquisitions, capital raising and integration before he shifted into commercial finance.

In 2010 he acquired part of Trade Finance Solutions, the business that became eCapital. Silvasan and his team moved from organic growth to a buy-and-build programme, adding factoring and asset-based lenders, consolidating them under one brand and investing in digital underwriting and servicing. He remains eCapital's chief executive, with Companies House recording a substantial voting and equity interest in its UK commercial-finance holding company.

The dossier therefore avoids both an unsupported independent-start subtype and any inheritance or family-transfer inference.

Operator reflects Silvasan's current chief-executive control and substantial disclosed UK ownership. eCapital's own history dates the business to 2006, while Silvasan says he acquired part in 2010; Founder would therefore misstate his current relationship to the principal finance asset even though he separately founded TelePlus.
